description: Ministry of Labour - The Collective Agreements between Kurunegala Plantations Limited (Clerical Staff) Vs. Ceylon Estate Staffs Union, Kurunegala Plantations Limited (Maintenance & Support Staff) Vs. Ceylon Estate Staffs Union and one other (E only)
